title: A Place in Space Is Colder Than Space Itself (Minus 272 C)

scenes.text: There's a place in space colder than space itself.
It's the Boomerang Nebula, about five thousand light years away.
Even empty space is warmed by the afterglow of the Big Bang, to about minus two hundred seventy degrees Celsius.
The Boomerang is colder, around minus two hundred seventy two.
Gas is rushing out of a dying star so fast that it chills itself.
The coldest natural place we know is a dying star.

description:
The Boomerang Nebula, about 5,000 light-years away, is colder than the afterglow of the Big Bang that warms empty space.
Its temperature is around minus 272 degrees Celsius, the coldest natural place known.
What do you think would happen if you flew into it? Comment below.
first_comment: The Boomerang Nebula is colder than empty space. What is the coldest you have ever been?
